{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Satin-blend blouse with a subtle sheen, relaxed collar and drop shoulders, soft midnight blue (#191A24), lightweight woven fabric.
High-waisted wide-leg trousers with a gentle drape, ankle length, charcoal grey (#363840), heavy crepe material.
Strappy block-heel sandals, slender silhouette to elongate the leg, deep burgundy (#5D0A1E), synthetic leather upper.

This outfit strikes the right balance for an evening restaurant date by elevating casual formality without becoming overly stiff. The relaxed blouse and wide-leg trousers provide comfort and elegance suitable for autumn weather in a dining setting, while the midnight blue and charcoal tones feel sophisticated yet approachable. Adding deep burgundy heels introduces a touch of romantic flair that complements the occasion perfectly, ensuring you look polished and confident."}
